_about: Every number, date, quote and coordinate that appears on screen, with its source. Text drawn on screen that contains a digit must name one of these keys (or a structural key); `make check` enforces it. `verified` is the date the value was checked against the source; `null` means it still has to be checked before that scene is rendered. Approximate figures carry ≈ on screen.

quote_washington.value: …perhaps as finally staked, on the experiment entrusted to the hands of the American people.
quote_washington.display: STAKED ON THE EXPERIMENT / ENTRUSTED TO THE HANDS OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE — WASHINGTON, FIRST INAUGURAL, 1789
quote_washington.note: Public domain. The original has a comma after 'staked'; the card uses the anchor wording from the brief.

pop_1776.note: Census Bureau Facts for Features: estimated population of the new nation in July 1776.

patent_act_1790.note: Art. I §8 empowers Congress to promote the progress of science and useful arts; the first Patent Act was signed April 10, 1790.

coord_camp_dubois.note: The Camp River Dubois replica at the Lewis and Clark State Historic Site, Hartford, Illinois. The 1803–04 winter camp stood nearby; the rivers have since moved.

coord_capitol.note: The 1844 telegraph message was sent from the Capitol to Baltimore.

telegraph_1844.note: Sent May 24, 1844 from the Supreme Court chamber in the Capitol to Baltimore.

quote_lincoln.value: that this nation, under God, shall have a new birth of freedom
quote_lincoln.note: Public domain. "A new birth of freedom" appears in every surviving copy of the address.

amendments.note: Ratification dates for the amendments; signing dates for the two acts (https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/civil-rights-act, https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/voting-rights-act).

steel_output.note: NBER Macrohistory series: steel ingots and castings. Curve shape and the end years only; no tonnage on screen.

patent_1900.note: The first utility patent issued in 1900.

wright_flight.note: First flight of December 17, 1903: 12 seconds, 120 feet. Also https://www.historynet.com/?p=3030051.

assembly_time.display: 12 H 30 M → 1 H 33 M PER CAR

assembly_built.note: About 15 million of one model built 1908–1927. No brand or model name on screen.

quote_fdr.value: We must be the great arsenal of democracy.
quote_fdr.note: Fireside chat of December 29, 1940. Public domain. Full text: https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/node/209416

liberty_ships.note: Eighteen yards, 1941–1945. A 1958 Proceedings note by the Maritime Commission chairman gives 2,708; 2,710 is the standard count.

aircraft_ww2.note: Nearly 300,000 military aircraft, 1940–1945 (296,431 by one official count).

life_expectancy.note: Health, United States, Table 15: life expectancy at birth, all persons.

quote_kennedy.value: We choose to go to the Moon in this decade and do the other things…

apollo11_pdi_altitude.note: Powered descent began from the descent orbit's low point, about 50,000 ft. The on-screen readout counts it down to 0 at touchdown.

quote_eagle.value: Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed.

coord_murray_hill.note: The Bell Labs campus at 600 Mountain Avenue, where the point-contact transistor was demonstrated in December 1947.

transistor_1947.note: First working point-contact transistor, December 16, 1947; demonstrated December 23.

microprocessor_1971.note: Announced November 15, 1971. No product name on screen.

chip_curve.unit: transistors, largest microprocessor of its year
chip_curve.note: Largest microprocessor transistor counts from the Wikipedia table; 134 billion in 2023. Log scale.

arpanet_lo.note: Sent from UCLA to SRI at about 10:30 pm; the system crashed after "LO".

tcpip_1983.note: The ARPANET switched from NCP to TCP/IP on January 1, 1983.

browser_1993.note: Released 1993. No product name on screen.

internet_users_2025.note: ≈ 6 billion, 74% of humanity (ITU). Checked by the prompt author.

ev_share_2025.display: 2025 · 1 IN 4 NEW CARS SOLD WORLDWIDE WAS ELECTRIC

booster_2015_2024.note: Catch: https://www.npr.org/2024/10/13/nx-s1-5151788/spacex-starship-booster-caught-first-launch. No company or vehicle names on screen.

genome_mrna.note: First mRNA vaccine authorized by the FDA on December 11, 2020: https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-takes-key-action-fight-against-covid-19-issuing-emergency-use-authorization-first-covid-19

transformer_2017.note: "Attention Is All You Need", submitted June 12, 2017.

ai_compute_growth.note: Epoch AI recommends 4–5× per year for notable and frontier models (4.1× per year, 2010–2024). The film draws that fitted trend, not individual models.

artemis2_distance.note: Passing Apollo 13's 248,655 mi. Checked by the prompt author.

kardashev.note: Sagan's formula K = (log10 P − 6) / 10, with world primary energy ≈ 592 EJ in 2024 (Energy Institute Statistical Review 2025: https://www.energyinst.org/statistical-review) → P ≈ 1.9 × 10^13 W → K ≈ 0.73.

land_ordinance_1785.value: townships six miles square, 36 sections of one square mile

acquisitions.note: The map groups present-day states into these acquisitions; boundaries are schematic.

corps_of_discovery.note: Left Camp Dubois May 14, 1804; reached St. Louis again September 23, 1806: 862 days. The counter runs out to the Pacific and back.

national_road_1811.note: Construction began at Cumberland, Maryland, in 1811: the first highway built with federal funds.

lightbulb_1879.note: The first long-burning carbon-filament test at Menlo Park ran October 21–22, 1879.

telephone_1876.note: Telephone patent issued March 7, 1876; the first call followed on March 10.

willow_run_rate.value: one bomber an hour at the 1944 peak
willow_run_rate.note: Shown as a clock hand making one turn per bomber; no figure on screen.

real_income.note: Census P60-47: up about $140 a year. Curve shape and end years only.

tv_households.note: Broadcasting, 1958 (1950 census 12 %; June 1955 67.2 %; January 1958 83 %); 1960 ≈ 87 % per later industry counts. Curve shape only.

arpanet_1969.note: The four nodes of December 1969, labelled by city: UCLA, SRI, UCSB and the University of Utah.

coord_lz1.note: Site of the first landing of an orbital-class booster, December 21, 2015.

coord_starbase.note: The launch site east of the city, where the first tower catch happened on October 13, 2024. Site listings give 25.997° N 97.156° W.

structural._about: Numbers that are part of the film's own apparatus rather than claims about the world.
structural.ruler: Timeline ruler labels and the cursor's year counter (1776–2026).
structural.open_coordinates: Unmeasured coordinates for the open future.
structural.dates: Scene date ranges in the HUD, which restate the years of the facts above.
